title.zh: CrowdCell Receipt 类型脚本 约束

subtitle.zh: 来源：alesfer001/CrowdCell / contracts/receipt/src/main.rs@acbb40e　·　0x5237…8bf8b5 (data2，仅测试网)　·　社区合约，未经独立审计
subtitle.en: Source: alesfer001/CrowdCell / contracts/receipt/src/main.rs@acbb40e　·　0x5237…8bf8b5 (data2, testnet only)　·　community contract, not independently audited

outputs.label: receipt
outputs.body: Cell{ type: { codeHash: RECEIPT, hashType: data2, args: {{pledge_code_hash 32B}} ‖ {{pledge_lock_code_hash 32B}} }, data(80B): {{amount}} ‖ {{backer}} ‖ {{campaign_hash}} ‖ {{deadline}} }

body.zh: 同一交易最多 1 个 receipt 输出
body.en: at most 1 receipt output per transaction

body.zh: 第一个 type code_hash = args[0..32] 且 data ≥ 72B 的输出；其 lock code_hash 须等于 args[32..64]
body.en: first output with type code_hash = args[0..32] and data ≥ 72B; its lock code_hash must equal args[32..64]

label.zh: receipt type args 字节布局（64B）

role.zh: pledge lock 的 code_hash（真正的 pledge 所在的 lock）
role.en: pledge lock code_hash (the lock a real pledge sits under)

label.zh: receipt data 字节布局（创建时 80B）
label.en: receipt data byte layout (80B at creation)

cond.zh: ≤ 1（同一交易中的 receipt 输出）
输出中存在 type code_hash = args[0..32] 且 data ≥ 72B 的 cell
cond.en: an output with type code_hash = args[0..32] and data ≥ 72B exists

cond.zh: pledge cell 的 lock code_hash = args[32..64]
pledge lock args ≥ 72B，且 [0..32] = campaign hash、[32..40] = deadline
cond.en: pledge lock args ≥ 72B and [0..32] = campaign hash, [32..40] = deadline

cond.zh: 加载 type script 失败
匹配的 pledge 输出的 lock 加载失败
cond.en: loading the matching pledge output's lock fails

title.en: Destroy receipt to reclaim its deposit

label.zh: receipt（每个 group input 单独检查）

body.zh: 脚本不检查 capacity 去向（由回执自身的 lock 决定，不在本合约内）
body.en: the script does not check where the capacity goes (the receipt's own lock decides, outside this contract)

cond.zh: 每个 group input ≥ 80 字节（40 字节旧格式不再接受）
cond.en: each group input ≥ 80 bytes (the 40-byte legacy form is rejected)

cond.zh: cell_deps 中有该 campaign type hash 的 cell，且其 data[56] ≠ 0（1 Success / 2 Failed）→ 通过
cond.en: a cell_dep with the campaign type hash and data[56] ≠ 0 (1 Success / 2 Failed) → passes

cond.zh: since 为绝对区块号且 ≥ deadline + 1,944,000 → 通过
cond.en: since is an absolute block number ≥ deadline + 1,944,000 → passes

cond.zh: 以上两条都不满足 → 不允许（每个 group input 都要满足）
cond.en: neither holds → not allowed (every group input must satisfy it)

cond.zh: 加载 group input 的 since 失败
cond.en: loading the group input's since fails

cond.zh: 输入与输出同时含 receipt 时不允许
cond.en: receipt in both inputs and outputs is not allowed

notes.zh: 错误码（contracts/receipt/src/main.rs，共 16 个）：9 LOAD_DATA · 10 INVALID_RECEIPT_DATA · 11 RECEIPT_MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED · 12 ZERO_PLEDGE_AMOUNT · 13 ZERO_BACKER_HASH · 14 NO_MATCHING_PLEDGE · 16 LOAD_LOCK · 19 LOAD_SCRIPT · 20 INVALID_ARGS · 21 AMOUNT_MISMATCH · 22 BACKER_MISMATCH · 23 CAMPAIGN_NOT_SETTLED · 24 CAMPAIGN_MISMATCH · 25 LOAD_SINCE · 26 NOT_PLEDGE_LOCK · 27 MULTIPLE_RECEIPTS。15、17、18 已不在源码中。
notes.en: Error codes (contracts/receipt/src/main.rs, 16 in total): 9 LOAD_DATA · 10 INVALID_RECEIPT_DATA · 11 RECEIPT_MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED · 12 ZERO_PLEDGE_AMOUNT · 13 ZERO_BACKER_HASH · 14 NO_MATCHING_PLEDGE · 16 LOAD_LOCK · 19 LOAD_SCRIPT · 20 INVALID_ARGS · 21 AMOUNT_MISMATCH · 22 BACKER_MISMATCH · 23 CAMPAIGN_NOT_SETTLED · 24 CAMPAIGN_MISMATCH · 25 LOAD_SINCE · 26 NOT_PLEDGE_LOCK · 27 MULTIPLE_RECEIPTS. 15, 17 and 18 are no longer in the source.

notes.zh: 创建时只检查找到的第一个 pledge 输出（type code_hash 匹配且 data ≥ 72B），其余输出不检查
notes.en: Creation checks only the first pledge output found (type code_hash matches and data ≥ 72B); other outputs are not checked

notes.zh: 所有回执共享同一个 script group，销毁时每个 group input 都要通过结算检查（不是只检查第一个）
notes.en: All receipts share one script group, so destruction checks every group input's settlement, not only the first

notes.zh: 回执只保护自己的押金，不能取走认捐资金；认捐资金由 pledge lock 结算
notes.en: A receipt only guards its own deposit and cannot take pledged funds; pledged funds are settled by the pledge lock

notes.zh: 回执押金 300 CKB 是前端按 (8 + 80 + 65 + 97) × 1.2 计算的常量（RECEIPT_CELL_CAPACITY），合约不检查 capacity
notes.en: The 300 CKB deposit is a frontend constant computed as (8 + 80 + 65 + 97) × 1.2 (RECEIPT_CELL_CAPACITY); the contract does not check capacity

notes.zh: 二进制：deployment/checksums-testnet.txt（acbb40e）记录的 blake2b 与上述 code_hash 相同；作者于 2026-11-04 在该 commit 用 ./scripts/build-contracts.sh 重新构建，五个合约的哈希均与测试网部署一致
notes.en: Binary: deployment/checksums-testnet.txt (acbb40e) records a blake2b equal to the code_hash above; the author rebuilt with ./scripts/build-contracts.sh at that commit on 2026-11-04 and all five hashes matched the testnet deployment

notes.zh: 解码器限制：cell_deps 数据不解析，“已结算”的 cell_dep 分支显示为未检查；since 宽限期分支可离线判断
notes.en: Decoder limitation: cell_dep data is not resolved, so the cell_dep settled branch shows as not checked; the since grace-period branch is checked offline

notes.zh: 没有 receipt cell 的交易，脚本直接返回 0（不是错误码）
notes.en: A transaction with no receipt cells returns 0 from the script (not an error code)
